articles.title: Lanterns Season Finale: Here's Our S01E08: "Dirt and Stars" Preview
articles.summary: HBO Max is set to premiere the eighth episode, "Dirt and Stars," of its highly anticipated series 'Lanterns,' starring Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler. The preview highlights the central mystery of "Who killed Hal Jordan?", promising a suspenseful narrative for viewers. This episode is expected to be a pivotal installment in the global superhero saga, attracting an international audience.

articles.title: Q3’s Horror Box Office Shows the Trouble with Always Hunting Another ‘Obsession’
articles.summary: The article discusses Hollywood's trend of mimicking the movie 'Obsession' in contemporary horror films. It introduces 'limerence,' a psychological term for an all-consuming romantic fixation, suggesting a deeper exploration of themes or psychological elements within these cinematic narratives. This piece touches upon evolving film styles and their potential connection to psychological concepts and audience engagement.

articles.title: Stephen Andrade’s CREEPSHOW Poster Brings Romero and King’s Horror Classic Back to Its Comic Book Roots
articles.summary: Artist Stephen Andrade created a new poster for the horror film Creepshow, commissioned by Hero Complex Gallery. The artwork masterfully captures the distinctive pulpy spirit of EC Comics, which originally inspired the movie. This creative endeavor highlights the enduring appeal of the classic horror anthology and its unique aesthetic, providing a nostalgic treat for fans.

articles.title: Lanterns: James Gunn Shares Some Final Thoughts Ahead of Season Finale
articles.summary: EP James Gunn shared final thoughts and a preview image ahead of the season finale for DC Studios and HBO's 'Lanterns'. This highly anticipated series, streaming on Max, concludes its season, reflecting significant developments within the globally popular DC franchise and generating fan excitement for the finale.

articles.title: Static Dread The Submarine-Razor1911
articles.summary: A psychological horror story, blending Lovecraftian dread with military reality, is set aboard a submarine trapped in the North Atlantic. This narrative explores the terrifying predicament of a military vessel submerged in the depths, facing unseen horrors. The unique premise combines existential fear with high-stakes defence themes, promising a compelling experience.

articles.title: Sex racket busted in hotel near district collectorate, 12 held
articles.summary: Prominent leader Suvendu Adhikari recently warned of bedbugs and, more significantly, urged for the uprooting of anti-national forces, underscoring internal security concerns. Concurrently, a protest erupted at a Ravenshaw girls' hostel following the discovery of worms in their food, highlighting issues with public health and administration.

articles.title: Khar businessman’s cook takes off to UP in a flight with stolen Rs 7.5 Lakh cash; nabbed after arrived back to Mumbai in his flight journey
articles.summary: A Khar, Mumbai businessman's cook stole Rs 7.5 Lakh cash and fled to Uttar Pradesh by flight. His escape was brief, as authorities successfully apprehended him upon his return to Mumbai via air. This incident highlights cross-state criminal activity and the efforts of law enforcement in tracing suspects who use domestic travel for their movements, ensuring justice for financial crimes.

articles.title: Kuki farmer found dead with hands tied in Manipur’s Kangpokpi
